overview: This file records U.S. monitoring of Japanese merchant ships in 1941–42 through diplomatic, naval, and consular reports. It documents vessel movements, repatriation voyages, cargoes, fuel sales, possible military use, and claims of immunity for requisitioned ships, alongside frequent relays and corrections sent to the Navy.
interest: Corrected telegrams and Navy relays reveal how officials tracked uncertain ship movements and possible military use before Pearl Harbor.
